readings: Which observatory stations (`observstation`) have an average of their telescopes’ non-missing `bandusagepct` values above the average of all non-missing telescope `bandusagepct` values? For each qualifying station, show the station, its average, and the difference between its average and the overall telescope average. Return the 10 largest differences first, without rounding.

Which observatory stations (`observstation`) have an average of their telescopes’ non-missing `bandusagepct` values above the unweighted average of the station averages, considering only stations with at least one non-missing value? For each qualifying station, show the station, its average, and the difference between its average and that overall station average. Return the 10 largest differences first, without rounding.
queries:
SELECT
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_average,
    AVG(bandusagepct) - (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes) AS difference
FROM telescopes
GROUP BY observstation
HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) > (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes)
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH station_averages AS (
    SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS station_avg
    FROM telescopes
    WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY observstation
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(station_avg) AS overall_avg
    FROM station_averages
)
SELECT
    s.observstation,
    s.station_avg,
    s.station_avg - o.overall_avg AS difference
FROM station_averages AS s
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE s.station_avg > o.overall_avg
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
